FAITH AMIDST THE TRAGEDY

LOOK: Some residents gather to hear a Holy Mass celebrated by Rev. Fr. Marti Sandino Espenido outside the Kalinis-linisang Puso ni Maria Chapel in NIA Road, Barangay Pinyahan, Quezon City on Sunday afternoon, Mach 8, 2026. 

The community was razed by a massive fire on Friday but the chapel miraculously stands unscathed. For the residents, the survival of the chapel has become a powerful symbol of faith amidst the tragedy. Up to 4,000 families were reportedly lost their homes, and one person died of a heart attack. | 📸: Grig C. Montegrande, Philippine Daily Inquirer
